info.title: API.SH: Magazine Luiza
info.description: The Magazine Luiza API from API.SH: public Magazine Luiza data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
Search suggestions Magazine Luiza shows while typing, in order, with their search links, and suggested products when the shop sends them. Without `query`: the shop's current top searches.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-autocomplete

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: The text typed so far, e.g. `gelad`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Suggestions, 1-30 (default 10).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The brands sold on Magazine Luiza, by first letter: name, slug and the search route listing the brand's products, with the total count for the letter. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-brands

parameters.name: letter
parameters.description: First letter or digit (default `a`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Brands per page, 1-200 (default 100).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Without `category`: Magazine Luiza's departments (id, name, description, link). With `category`: that department's tree (subcategories up to four levels) with ids, names, page titles, descriptions and links. Use the ids in `/magalu/v1/search` (`category`, `subcategory`).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A department id such as `TE` or `ED`.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: A subcategory id inside `category`, e.g. `TEIP`, to read only its branch.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Magazine Luiza product: id, variation id, link, title, type, brand, department and subcategory, availability, price, list price, best price and its method (e.g. Pix), rating and count, review count, rating breakdown (1-5 stars) and rated aspects, description, highlights, the full specification sheet, part numbers, variation options (color, storage, voltage...) with their product ids, dimensions and weight, bundles, images and videos. `offers` lists every seller offering it (up to `sellers`), each with the seller's name, legal name, CNPJ, address, score, total sales, delivery and answer rates, price, list price, Pix price, best installment plan, the full installment table per payment method (installments, amount, total, interest), promotions, badges, maximum quantity and extended-warranty offers.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id such as `242487600` or `ja9e13fj6d`, or a magazineluiza.com.br product link (…/p/<id>/…).

parameters.name: sellers
parameters.description: How many seller offers to return, 1-30 (default 10).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Return this seller's offer first (a seller id, e.g. `kabum`).

parameters.name: zipcode
parameters.description: A Brazilian CEP (8 digits) to price and rank offers for that address.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of a Magazine Luiza product (reviews are shared by the product's variations): rating, title, text, date, reviewer first name, the variation they bought (e.g. color, storage), rated aspects, photos and videos; plus the average rating, rating count, review count, rating breakdown (1-5 stars) and rated aspects. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id such as `242487600`, or a magazineluiza.com.br product link.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Order (default `relevance`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (default 1).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Reviews per page, 1-50 (default 20).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Magazine Luiza (magazineluiza.com.br, Brazil's largest retailer and marketplace) product search and category browse, up to 100 products a page. Each item: product id, variation id, link, title, brand, department and subcategory, availability, price, list price, best price and its payment method (e.g. Pix with discount), best installment plan, the selling seller (id, name, SKU), badges and discounts, rating and review count, delivery estimate tag when a CEP is given, a sponsored flag, whether other sellers offer it, the variation options (color, storage, voltage...) with their product ids and an image. Also returns the total (10,000 at most), the corrected query, the sort options and `facets`: the attribute filters the shop shows for the query (color, voltage, capacity, storage, screen size, condition, delivery...) with counts, plus the top brands. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-search

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Search keywords (Portuguese works best). Optional when `category`, `subcategory`, `brand` or `seller` is given (then the call browses them).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: A department id such as `ED` (appliances) or `TE` (phones), from `/magalu/v1/categories`. Several, comma-separated.

parameters.name: subcategory
parameters.description: A subcategory id such as `REFR` or `TEIP`, from `/magalu/v1/categories?category=…`. Several, comma-separated.

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: A brand slug such as `brastemp` or `apple` (from `facets` or `/magalu/v1/brands`). Several, comma-separated.

parameters.name: min_price
parameters.description: Lowest price in reais, e.g. `1000`.

parameters.name: max_price
parameters.description: Highest price in reais, e.g. `3000`.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Attribute filters from `facets` (each value's `filter`), separated by `;`, e.g. `cor:branco;voltagem:110v`. Values of the same attribute are combined with OR, different attributes with AND.

parameters.name: magalu_delivery
parameters.description: true for products delivered by Magalu only.

parameters.name: include_unavailable
parameters.description: false to leave out products that are out of stock (default true, as the shop does).

parameters.name: zipcode
parameters.description: A Brazilian CEP (8 digits) for the delivery estimate tags and the `fastest_delivery` / `lowest_total_price` sorts.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort order (default `relevance`).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1-200 (default 1). Pass back `next_page`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Products per page, 1-100 (default 60).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Only this marketplace seller's offers: a seller id such as `kabum` (from a product's `offers[].seller.id`).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
A Magazine Luiza marketplace seller's page: name, legal name, CNPJ, description, seller since, official-store and chat flags, score, total sales, followers, delivery and answer rates, business address, logo, cover image and the categories and brands it features. A seller that is a person (not a company) comes with its name, legal name, city and state; its personal tax number and street address are left out. Its products: `/magalu/v1/seller-products`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-seller

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A seller id such as `kabum` (from a product's `offers[].seller.id`), or a magazineluiza.com.br/lojista/<id>/ link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Delivery options for a Magazine Luiza product to a Brazilian CEP: each option's name and type (standard, express, store pickup...), price, delivery time in working days, the expected delivery date and its text, plus the seller's free-shipping group and policy notes. An unknown CEP answers 400.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/magalu-shipping

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A product id such as `242487600`, or a magazineluiza.com.br product link.

parameters.name: zipcode
parameters.description: The destination CEP, 8 digits (e.g. `01310100`).

parameters.name: seller
parameters.description: Quote this seller's offer (a seller id from the product's `offers`); default the main offer.

parameters.name: quantity
parameters.description: Units, 1-50 (default 1).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
